decisions.summary: Wave 83's fillet radius and wave 84's fork band patches re-run on the hardened web; both stay reverted, their rows held at E3
decisions.why: No finding is dropped: the rows stay open in the ranking at E3 and are taken in tier order (FR-003, SC-003); keeping a patch that breaks seeds out of main is constitution XIII. The figures match m:retake-after-wave89 (49/54 with 31, 32, 40, 43 newly failing and 10 newly passing; 48/54 with 23, 40, 902, 904 newly failing).

decisions.summary: Two guards under XIV: door_off_fixtures steps a door only to where a path's end still arrives (_arrives_at), and _one_joint refuses a pull that moves an arriving joint out of reach (arrives_off)
decisions.why: This is a defect fix that serves an open request row: it was found by probing why the reverted fillet patch failed seed 902, and it removes that seed from the fillet's regressions (m:wave90-door-ends-arrive: 902 WebRefused -> OK under the patch). Alone on HEAD the cohort holds 52/54, nothing is newly failing and no pool map moves, so the implementation is not moved away from any page. It narrows nothing the GM asked for. Both guards use end_serves, the lane law's own predicate on 0246, which this repository uses as its research page, so they do what they say.

decisions.summary: Seed 10's field-way refusal diagnosed and filed as a found row (E3)
decisions.why: Filing it adds to the ranking and drops nothing. It is tiered by FR-003's definition and fixed in tier order.

decisions.summary: No Decisions Recorded row for wave 90
decisions.why: FR-008 requires a row only for a fix that changes what a map draws or states. Measured: no pool map moved, and the cohort is unchanged on HEAD.

decisions.summary: lay_door_paths' MISLABELED claim re-cited from 0036 to 0246/0081 (in the diff, not the plan)
decisions.why: FR-003's E0 covers a claim whose citation is wrong. The new citations hold the content: 0081 draws a footpath 3 ft wide and 0246 sets the 60 ft reach. Neither page was edited, and the implementation is unchanged.
